query: Consider LTI's Two-Way Confidential Disclosure Agreement; Does the document indicate that the Agreement does not grant the Receiving Party any rights to the Confidential Information?
gold: 9) Nothing contained in this Non-Disclosure Agreement shall, by express grant, implication, estoppel or otherwise, create in either Party any right, title, interest, or license in or to the Proprietary Information, inventions, patents, technical data, computer software, or software documentation of the other Party.
rag_answer: Yes. The document expressly states in Section 9 that nothing in the Non-Disclosure Agreement shall, by express grant, implication, estoppel, or otherwise, create in either party any right, title, interest, or license in or to the other party’s Proprietary Information, inventions, patents, technical data, computer software, or software documentation. Therefore, it does not grant the Receiving Party any rights to the confidential/proprietary information.

judge.gold_summary: 第9条规定，该保密协议不通过明示授予、默示、禁反言或其他方式，赋予任何一方对另一方专有信息、发明、专利、技术数据、计算机软件或软件文档的任何权利、所有权、利益或许可。
judge.answer_summary: 系统回答指出第9条明确不通过明示授予、默示、禁反言或其他方式创造任何权利、所有权、利益或许可，因此协议不授予接收方对机密/专有信息的权利。
judge.reason: 系统回答准确覆盖了金标关键条款和结论，虽然表述为机密/专有信息，但与金标中的 Proprietary Information 含义一致，且结论与金标相符。
